style.vernacular: Planned plateau capital (c.1,050 m, 1970s master plan): low-rise Old Town of arcaded shop rows, markets and bus stations; a New City/Capital Hill of 1970s-2010s government blocks and Chinese-funded civic buildings in cream or white render with flat or lightly pitched roofs; face-brick and render houses behind walls with red or grey corrugated iron roofs; malls with plain painted-render boxes and glass entrance bays; red-brown earth and broadleaf trees everywhere.
style.ornament: Little applied ornament: plain rendered walls, deep concrete eaves and sun-breaks on 1970s government blocks, colonnaded shop fronts with awnings in Old Town, national flags and flagpoles at civic sites, painted signage murals on market walls; traditional round huts with grass thatch only at cultural-village sites.

sources.what: planned multi-centred linear city, Old Town (markets, bus stations) vs New City (hotels, embassies, offices), Capital Hill in Area 20, plateau at ~1,050 m, humid subtropical climate
